meta.name: histolab
meta.description: Lightweight WSI tile extraction and preprocessing. Use for basic slide processing, tissue detection, tile extraction, and stain normalization for H&E images. Best for simple pipelines, dataset preparation, and quick tile-based analysis. For advanced spatial proteomics, multiplexed imaging, or deep learning pipelines use pathml.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从病理切片中提取组织块并预处理图像
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要处理H&E染色切片并提取组织块用于下游分析
copy.tagline_en: Extract tissue tiles from pathology slides and preprocess images
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently work with H&E stained slides and need to extract tissue tiles for downstream analysis

howto.what: 装上这个技能后，Claude 能用 histolab 库处理数字病理全切片图像：自动检测组织区域、从超大扫描图中切出小图块、对 H&E 染色图像做染色归一化，并生成缩略图或评分报告。
howto.when: 当你说到“组织检测”“切图块”“染色归一化”等关键词，或要求处理病理切片时触发。

say.text: 用GridTiler把这个切片的组织区域全部切成512×512的图块
say.note: 会先预览图块位置再提取

say.text: 用Macenko染色归一化处理这张HE切片
say.note: 需要你提供参考染色图

say.text: 帮我用NucleiScorer选出核密度最高的50个图块
say.note: 会生成带评分报告的图块

howto.what_en: Enables Claude to process whole-slide pathology images with histolab: detect tissue, extract tiles, normalize H&E stains, and produce thumbnails or scored reports.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention keywords like "tissue detection", "tile extraction", or "stain normalization", or ask to process pathology slides.

say_en.text: Extract all tissue as 512x512 tiles with GridTiler.
say_en.note: Tile locations are previewed before extraction.

say_en.text: Normalize this H&E slide with Macenko stain normalization.
say_en.note: Provide a reference stain image first.

say_en.text: Pick the 50 highest-density tiles with NucleiScorer.
